_readme: This is the only file you should ever need to edit by hand.
The site rebuilds itself from the App Store every day, so a newly approved app
appears on its own. It lands in a group chosen from its App Store genre and gets
a subtitle taken from the first line of its store description. If you want it
somewhere else, or want better words, add an entry under 'apps' below.
An app listed under 'comingSoon' disappears from that section automatically the
day it goes live, and reappears in its real group. Nothing to clean up.
